402410101.text: Alright, we're all set. The baku have been fasting all night, so we should be able to get rid of this nightmare no problem.

402410102.text: These are the fragments we collected.

402410103.text: Mm, the scent matches what we found earlier. Yep, these are the ones. Here goes nothing.

402410104.text: Hey, looks like Popcorn is back to normal!

402410105.text: Phew... Finally, I don't feel so dizzy anymore.

402410106.text: I remember now... I remember everything! Thank you for keeping me company these past few days and helping Homura overcome her nightmare!

402410107.text: Hehe, our pleasure! How did you get separated from Homura, anyway? Aren't imaginary friends supposed to live inside kids' heads?

402410108.text: Well, actually... Homura is all grown up now...

402410109.text: Her work's been so busy and stressful — she can't even sleep most nights. And when she finally found some time to relax out in nature, she had a nightmare the minute she tried to take a nap...

402410110.text: I just wanted to give her a chance to rest, so I tried to get rid of the nightmare by going inside of it and beating up all the things tormenting her.

402410111.text: But then... I got swept up in a massive storm, and when Homura woke up, an ominous-looking shard was left behind, right where she was sleeping!

402410113.text: Yeah! So, I tried to smash it to pieces!

402410114.text: Guess Popcorn's temper wasn't just the nightmare talking...

402410115.text: No, but it definitely made it more extreme.

402410116.text: But I failed again! Then, I got super dizzy, and well... You know the rest.

402410117.text: Well, we got rid of all the nightmare fragments, right? So is the problem solved?

402410118.text: Homura is free from the nightmare, but her psychological state is still abnormal... In fact, the problem could be quite serious.

402410119.text: While digesting the fragments just now, the baku sensed that there was no attempt from Homura to overcome the emotions contained within them... which is a sign of emotional numbness.

402410120.text: She hasn't given a sincere smile in ages. She doesn't let her imagination run wild like she did as a kid, or think up crazy scenes in her head...

402410121.text: I can't encourage her through her imagination like I used to... All I can do is watch her lose her spark.

402410122.text: When someone gives up on seeking and relishing in their own happiness, negative emotions can become all-consuming. And if that happens...

402410124.text: We see patients like this a lot at the clinic. On the outside, it might seem like nothing is wrong.

402410125.text: But on the inside, a sense of emptiness begins to take over, until the person loses the capacity to recognize beauty in the world.

402410126.text: As one of our patients put it: "It's not that I'm gone, it's the knowledge that my inner child is never coming back."

402410127.text: No, no! I have to help her!

402410128.text: Where did she go? Will she be back for dinner?

402410129.text: No, Qiqi. That was just a metaphor or, um... personification? One of the two.

402410130.text: Who says she can't come back! Sometimes after I get let out of confinement, I dash off so fast even Master Jean can't catch me!

402410131.text: But then, Dodoco reminds me that's a sure-fire way to get sent back to confinement, so I turn around and go back.

402410132.text: Well, that's a more... literal take, but Paimon thinks the logic still applies!

402410133.text: Yeah, I think so too. If anyone has a chance of getting through to her, it'd be Popcorn, right? He is her imaginary friend, after all. She has to listen to him.

402410134.text: True. I'd hate for her to get to the point of needing professional help. If she can work through these problems on her own, even better.

402410135.text: But Popcorn said Homura hasn't thought about him in ages... She's not gonna be able to hear him or talk to him...

402410136.text: Which is why our first priority is to get her to remember him...

402410137.text: I have to find Homura! I have to help her!

402410139.text: The Little Hexenzirkel wants to help too!

402410201.text: Homura, the proposal you submitted still has issues. It needs to be more creative, it needs that spark! Back to the drawing board.

402410202.text: Your ideas were so good when you first started working here. What happened? You know how crucial this pitch is for us. We value your work, but you need to get your head in the game.

402410203.text: But, this is already the 12th draft... *sigh* Never mind. Understood.

402410204.text: Wait, that's Homura? Isn't that the girl we met outside of Aisa Bathhouse a few days ago?

402410205.text: That person Popcorn keeps ramming into must be her boss. It doesn't seem like either of them can see him...

402410206.text: Homura still doesn't remember Popcorn. So she can't see him.

402410207.text: Guess she doesn't wear her hair in pigtails now that she's all grown up, huh.

402410208.text: Well, long hair is a lot of work.

402410209.text: And no more flowery dresses either...

402410210.text: Well, my mom says pants are easier to work in. But, I suppose it's just a matter of wearing what's comfortable.

402410211.text: There's an exhibition being held in a few days. You need to find some time and show the client around. Take good care of him, alright? Our orders for the next year depend on it!

402410212.text: Oh, and draw up a diagram while you're at it. You're always doodling something or other, aren't you? Doesn't need to look that impressive up close. Just enough to impress the client during the presentation.

402410213.text: Draw up a sketch. The actual content doesn't matter, just make it look good. We'll change it later depending on the client's feedback.

402410214.text: Man, that workload is triggering my fight or flight... Or just flight to be honest...

402410215.text: C'mon, Homura! Stand up for yourself!

402410217.text: Ugh, c'mon! Where's that explosive temper you had as a kid... Like in that poem you wrote!

402410218.text: Wait, that's it! The poem! We can use that to remind her of her childhood, and get her to remember Popcorn!

402410219.text: Bring on the tear-bugs. Bring on the booger-beasts...

402410221.text: Mean, or nasty, or in your face, one punch sends them to outer space!

402410223.text: Give them one great monstrous whack... Wait, what comes next? Sayu?

402410224.text: Um... Shoot. I think I dozed off during that part...

402410225.text: Give them one great monstrous whack, then... stuff... stuff 'em in a big ol' sack!

402410226.text: Yeah, I've got a sack with your name on it!

402410228.text: What is it? Confused about something?

402410229.text: I think you're the one who's confused. Your feedback changes from one moment to the next. You don't even know what you want, but somehow, you expect me to read your mind? Maybe if you actually thought things through, we wouldn't have to redo them.

402410230.text: You want me to make the decisions? Fine, then don't micromanage me. You nitpick everything I do, just to complain again when I change it. You talk about a lack of creativity, but I don't see you coughing up ideas.

402410231.text: You say the company values me? Ha! Really? 'Cause I work myself into the ground every day, and do I even get a free cup of coffee to keep myself awake? No, I buy it myself.

402410232.text: Of course we plan to reward our hard workers with several level—

402410233.text: I'm not done. You wanna talk about rewards? 'Cause it seems like you just reward us with more work. Half the work I do is outside my job description.

402410234.text: I'm not a machine. You can't just wind me up and keep me running forever.

402410235.text: I'm overworked. I don't get enough sleep, I... I can't keep going on like this.

402410236.text: You're my boss. If I can't have your mentorship and guidance, the least you could do is create a suitable working environment.

402410237.text: Oh, and drawing is what I do for fun, not another thing you get to use to order me around. So just... shut up!

402410238.text: Woof! Took the words right out of my mouth!

402410240.text: Okay... You're upset. I see that, and... You're right! I put too much on your plate. I'm sorry.

402410241.text: You should take some time to relax and recharge. How about a three-month paid vacation?

402410243.text: Ah, of course. Put my Mora where my mouth is, right? I'll add on a three months' bonus. How does that sound?

402410244.text: A three months' bonus... three months' bonus... three months' bonus... three months' bonus...

402410247.text: Haha... Ha... Hm? Oh, um. Yes.

402410250.text: Actually, no. Everything is not okay!

402410251.text: I think the proposal I submitted is more than competitive enough. Maybe I could talk you through it, and then you can decide whether changes are really necessary.

402410252.text: But first... I'd like to take two days off. We can go over it when I get back.

402410254.text: Listen, I get that things come up, but now's not the best time. We're up against some tight deadlines, so just hang in there...

402410255.text: I'm sorry, but I can't... I have too much work, and it's starting to impact my health. I hope you can understand...

402410256.text: Huh, you never said anything, and your work is always on time, so I just assumed you could handle it.

402410257.text: I complete my work on time because I'm a professional. It's those unreasonable, last-minute tasks that force me to work overtime...

402410258.text: And I've been doing that a lot lately... I was hoping you could... be a little more mindful of the work you assign me in the future.

402410259.text: But, the client is going to be here soon. How am I going to find someone on such short notice?

402410260.text: Entertaining clients was never part of my job description to begin with...

402410261.text: *sigh*... Of course, if you really can't approve my time off, I've made peace with having to—

402410262.text: Now, hold on just one minute! No need to be rash! How about this? Rest up, get yourself back in working order, and your position will be waiting... Just don't make it too long, okay?

402410301.text: Whoa... that was close. I was about to say I'd made peace with having to meet the client...

402410303.text: Popcorn! It's really you! Oh, and... you're not alone.

402410304.text: Hello, Miss Homura! We're Popcorn's friends!

402410305.text: Wait, so... My imaginary friend has real-world friends besides me? This isn't also in my imagination, is it...?

402410306.text: Popcorn explains what happened, with the little witches chiming in with details here and there...

402410307.text: I see... Thanks for doing that. I haven't been doing so hot lately, so I've been having nightmares. Sorry you had to go through all that trouble.

402410308.text: Don't worry. The nightmare's been devoured, so you should be able to get a good night's sleep from now on!

402410309.text: But the Dough King said you still have mental issues.

402410310.text: Wait, no. That's not... You can't just say that, Qiqi. Adults can't handle being that direct.

402410311.text: So, um, anyway... Popcorn said you've been really busy at work?

402410312.text: Yeah... This is my first job. I was so excited at the start, thinking this was my chance to make a name for myself. But, reality turned out to be pretty harsh...

402410313.text: Endless work, difficult relationships, and plans that fall through... I couldn't even solve one problem before even bigger ones would pop up.

402410314.text: It was suffocating. Even after getting off work, I was too tired to do the things I used to enjoy. All I wanted to do was lie down.

402410315.text: I know exactly what you mean. The adult world is a cold and cruel place.

402410316.text: How in the— You're not even an adult!

402410317.text: Huh, I don't get it at all. We all live in the same world, right? Mom said grown-ups are just big kids in grown-up clothes!

402410319.text: Yeah, I've gathered a lot of intel about this. Turns out, when no one's looking, some grown-ups play their own games too, or put on little puppet shows, or even pretend to cook stuff!

402410321.text: Nothing has to change! We can still fight monsters, or pretend the floor is lava. You just have to picture it, and we can do it!

402410322.text: Kinda like how I imagined going on that rant just now...? Even though it wasn't real, just picturing it felt pretty cathartic.

402410323.text: That's not enough, though. Children are innocent. Their fantasies become real to them, so make-believe gives them genuine happiness.

402410324.text: But adults know it isn't real, so imagination becomes a form of self-deception. It's called a mental escapade.

402410327.text: Oh, right! Yes, that. Shoot... I memorized it wrong.

402410328.text: The point is, you can't just fantasize about the things that make you happy. You have to take action!

402410329.text: That goes for work and regular life. Whether it's "something" or "someone" that's getting you down, you never have to accept the status quo. Just like earlier, saying "no" is the first step.

402410330.text: And if it continues to stand in your way, just give it the old tear-bug and booger-beast treatment!

402410332.text: And if all else goes wrong, I guess the worst-case scenario is... you just find a new job.

402410333.text: Yeah, that's— Uhh, actually, not sure if that'd be something to celebrate...

402410334.text: Huh... I never thought kids would be the ones to give me a much-needed pep talk, but you make some great points. I'll try to take a different approach. Oh, and thanks for everything.

402410401.text: Aww. It's so nice seeing Popcorn and Homura together again...

402410403.text: Makes me think about Descartes... Wait a second, what am I even doing!? I've barely made any progress!

402410406.text: It's okay. If you don't want to talk about it, we can pretend we didn't hear anything.

402410407.text: But if you do choose to trust us with it, I'm sure we'd all be more than willing to help out. Right, little witches?

402410408.text: Yeah! In my heart, Prune is already one of us! We all like you a lot!

402410409.text: Definitely! We worked super well tracking down those fragments. It's like we were made for each other!

402410410.text: Plus, our heights all match too! You even taught me how to use a hammer like a pair of stilts, so I could feel what it'd be like to be taller.

402410411.text: Prune knows a lot and likes sharing. She gave me a book on finches.

402410412.text: Paimon seconds all that! Besides, she's so used to you being a part of the Little Hexenzirkel now, she can barely imagine divvying up snacks without counting your share!

402410413.text: You guys... *sob*... I'm not... I'm not that great...

402410414.text: I've been lying from the start. I'm not Alice's friend!

402410415.text: I'm a Witch Hunter. Witches are my enemies! I'd never be friends with someone like her!

402410416.text: She challenged me to a debate, and when she lost, she took my imaginary friend away... Like it was nothing! *sobbing*... Descartes is my best friend...

402410417.text: She said the only way to save him was to defeat all the witches...

402410418.text: I went to Mondstadt to find them, only for the trail to lead me to Inazuma. So I took a boat overnight to get here... and then...

402410419.text: I met you guys instead... It wasn't supposed to be like this!

402410420.text: You're not evil witches at all, just a group of innocent kids... And... And you've been so nice to me. I can't treat you like my enemies, I just... I can't... *sobbing*

402410421.text: It's okay, it's okay. Just let it out.

402410422.text: The little witches stay by Prune's side, holding her hand and patting her on the back, until eventually, she calms down...

402410423.text: I, um... feel a lot better now. Thanks.

402410424.text: But, uh.... crying like that in front of everyone was super embarrassing. Maybe it could be our little secret?

402410426.text: Prune, could Paimon ask... Did you actually see Alice take Descartes away?

402410427.text: Well, no. I didn't see how she did it.

402410428.text: Then... did she say how you're supposed to defeat the other witches?

402410429.text: There were no specifics... But, I'm sure she expects me to fight them or something. That's what a villain would do, right?

402410430.text: Well, in our experience, Alice's trials are usually a bit more... unconventional. Besides... she wouldn't be that mean.

402410431.text: I don't care what kind of trick she has in store. I'm a Witch Hunter, and that won't change. So, I don't think me and the other little witches can be—

402410435.text: Yeah! The Little Hexenzirkel didn't exist when Alice issued that challenge. You can join, for sure!

402410436.text: The Little Hexenzirkel can band together to defeat the big witches and save your imaginary friend!

402410438.text: Um, I'm kinda confused about the details, but I bet it's supposed to be a big, fun game!

402410439.text: Cause Mom always says I'm gonna beat her one day and become the bestest witch in the whole wide world!

402410440.text: Catching the big witches sounds like a fun game to me! I wanna play for sure!

402410441.text: Sounds like a chance to get in some good training. Count me in.

402410442.text: I'm trying to become an even stronger ninja than my sensei too. That way, I can sleep as much as I want and nobody can say a thing.

402410443.text: Master said that's called when "the branch grows higher than the tree." We all want that, right, Qiqi?

402410445.text: #Plus, Paimon and {NICKNAME} have been around the block with all this witch stuff. With us around, we can defeat whatever great, big, powerful, impressive mages we want!

402410447.text: You guys... are a really awesome group of kids, you know that?

402410448.text: Hehe, just give me your hand, and you'll be an official member of the Little Hexenzirkel!

402410449.text: I guess I can do kid things with all of you... Ahem, to go along with the group, I mean. Alright, I'll join.

402410451.text: No, I'm not that much of a kid.

402410452.text: Fine, fine. You don't have to give me that look... I'll say it.

402410453.text: Little witch Prune reporting for duty...

402410456.text: But, I haven't defeated the witches... Did you escape on your own? Are you hurt? Here, let me see.

402410457.text: Wait, what's going on? Is it Descartes?

402410458.text: Yeah, he's back! He's really back!

402410460.text: He said... it's a long story, and he'll explain later.

402410462.text: What do you mean "weird"? He's adorable! Hold on... You can see him?

402410463.text: Wait, are these... your imaginary friends? How come I can see them?

402410464.text: Wow... look at all of them!

402410465.text: Tuantuan flew away... She wants to go play over there.

402410466.text: C'mon, c'mon! Let's go! All the imaginary friends can play together!

402410501.text: Did you see that? Everyone's imaginary friends are here... in the real world!

402410502.text: Let's catch up and see what's happening!

subQuests.subQuestName: Check on the little witches and their imaginary friends

402410503.text: Real or imaginary... seeing all these friends together like this is a wonderful sight.

402410506.text: #Hehe... Astute as ever, {NICKNAME}. Consider it a well-earned gift for the Little Hexenzirkel for completing their grand quest!

402410507.text: I just thought I'd give all our lovely imaginary friends a chance to come out and say hello. What a lively gathering this turned out to be!

402410601.text: So... it was all a misunderstanding?

402410603.text: Hmph! That makes it even worse! She tricked me!

402410605.text: Hold on, I never said I regretted coming here. And no, I don't regret joining the Little Hexenzirkel either.

402410701.text: Whoa, I never thought Gena would be so big!

402410702.text: Her belly is super soft too. It's a great spot for a nap.

402410703.text: Hm, very tall. Taller than Sayu.

402410705.text: Oooh, I can warm us all up! Sparks 'n' Splash!

402410801.text: Are you... disappointed in me, Popcorn? All those dreams I had as a kid, and I haven't achieved a single one. I grew up to be a pathetic adult, huh...

402410802.text: Can you eat as much tempura as you want, day in and day out?

402410804.text: Can you buy your favorite light novels and manga without having to ask an adult?

402410805.text: Yeah, I make my own Mora, so I can buy whatever I want.

402410806.text: Then you're an amazing little adult in my book!

402419901.text: Ah, Popcorn's over there! C'mon, let's get closer.
